thread:
samir: Heads-up: scheduling base-image rebuild + KMS rotation next Wed 02:00 UTC. Main blocker: our HSM keys refuse direct userland calls (cosign). Proposing a minimal signing-proxy that performs KMS:Sign on behalf of CI. Need RBAC split, network constraints, audit enrichment, SBOM gating, and a rollback playbook. cc @rachel @tom @jenny
rachel: RBAC sketch:
- base-builder SA: build/push only, NO access to secrets or KMS.
- image-signer SA: allowed only kms:Sign on a single key version, no other k8s privileges.
- signing-proxy SA: token via tokenRequest TTL=30m, annotated audited=true.
We should also prevent builder SA from ever getting `image-signer` bindings (OPA/webhook).
tom: Network + runtime constraints: signing-proxy runs in a dedicated signing subnet (no internet egress), nodeAffinity -> signing-nodes pool, taint/toleration so only signed pods land there. Egress allowed only to KMS endpoints and splunk ingestion. No mounting of registry creds in proxy.
jenny: Audit/logs: proxy + cosign must emit structured JSON-lines with at least: {"op":"sign","key_version":"v2","signer_principal":"svc-image-signer@redwood","pod_uid":"...","image_digest":"sha256:...","status":"ok|fail"}. Route to splunk index `images_sign` and to auditpipe (prod 365d / staging 90d). Add fluentd extractor to map signer_principal -> splunk field.
samir: Add cosign invocation guidance in CI: `cosign sign --annotations signer=svc-image-signer@redwood --output json <image>` so we have signer identity in stdout. Proxy should return raw signature and include `pod_uid` header so KMS logs correlate to k8s.
rachel: OPA policy (draft):
```
package rbac_deny

deny[msg] {
  input.binding.role == "image-signer"
  input.binding.subject.kind == "ServiceAccount"
  input.binding.subject.name == "base-builder"
  msg = "builders cannot be granted signer privileges"
}
```
Deploy as mutating/admission deny for RoleBindings and ClusterRoleBindings. Unit tests required.
tom: Registry protection: protect last 20 signed tags for each base image and mark them immutable for 7 days after rotation. This prevents accidental GC of fallback images. Also add a retention policy to avoid unbounded storage growth.
ci-bot: ci: staging-rebuild-1771234567 queued -> sbom-scan -> sign-via-proxy -> cosign-verify -> canary-smoke
infra-bot: preflight: found missing IAM condition on KMS binding for svc-image-signer in prod. Recommend time-bound condition and VPC source restriction.
jenny: Suggested IAM condition (pseudo):
```
condition: request.time < timestamp("2026-10-01T04:00:00Z") && request.auth.aud == "svc-image-signer@redwood" && source.ip in ["10.11.12.0/24"]
```
We'll need infra to craft cloud-specific binding. Also insist on key versions so we can roll back.
samir: Rollback playbook (short):
1) Abort rebuilds and block new deploys.
2) Keep previous signed images promoted / pinned.
3) Re-enable previous key version (do not delete).
4) Run cluster-wide `cosign verify` job and scan for mismatches.
5) If verify green -> resume. If verify fails -> page sec-oncall and escalate to incident channel.
sec-oncall: Add alert rules:
- `cosign.verify.fail_rate > 0.5%` over 5m -> page sec-oncall
- `signing-proxy.errors > 1` per minute -> page infra-oncall
Also add a PagerDuty runbook link in the alert.
tom: SBOM gating: run dependency-scan and compare SBOMs. If any NEW CVE with severity >= 7.0 appears in the delta, block rollout and auto-open security-triage ticket with SBOM diff attached. CI should annotate the PR with `triage:blocking` when triggered.
rachel: Who's primary for the window? I'll take primary for RBAC and webhook, @tom will own network/runtime, @jenny owns logging/audit. Samir primary owner for the rotation itself. Please review RBAC PR in 48h.
ci-bot: ci: staging-rebuild-1771234567 started
infra-bot: Note: ensure signing-proxy logs include `x-pod-uid` header on KMS calls so KMS audit logs can be correlated to k8s objects.
jenny: I'll add fluentd/parsers and dashboards for quick lookup (search by signer_principal + image_digest). Also adding a cron job to verify signatures across canaries for 24h post-rotation.
samir: Good. I'll create calendar invite for the maintenance window and link PRs + runbook. Post blockers here. :thumbsup:
rachel: Minor: add webhook unit tests and an integration that tries to bind base-builder -> image-signer to verify denial.
tom: Also add nodePressure tolerance checks for signing-nodes; we don't want signing-proxy evicted mid-sign. Add pod disruption budget with minAvailable=1.
samir: Thanks all. If no blockers, we'll cutover the dry-run in staging next Tue then prod the following week.
